rewrites.before:
Before fanning out, find this conversation's transcript in the `agent-transcripts/` directory the system prompt names. Do not glob across `~/.cursor/projects/*/`. That crosses workspace boundaries and reads private chats from unrelated projects.

```bash
ls -t <agent-transcripts>/*.jsonl <agent-transcripts>/*/*.jsonl <agent-transcripts>/*/subagents/*.jsonl 2>/dev/null | head -10
```

That covers the legacy flat (`<id>.jsonl`), current nested (`<id>/<id>.jsonl`), and subagent (`<parent>/subagents/<child>.jsonl`) layouts. For each candidate, read the first JSONL line. Take the file whose `message.content[0].text` contains the conversation's opening user prompt. If none matches, pass a tight digest of the session instead.
rewrites.after: Before fanning out, call `pstack_history(action: "current")` to identify this conversation exactly. Export its full messages with `pstack_history(action: "export", sessionID: ...)`. The returned private JSONL includes messages from before compaction, with native message IDs, types and timestamps. Pass that absolute path to the reviewers; do not inline the raw transcript. Do not search unrelated workspaces. If a full transcript is unavailable, pass a tight digest and state that limitation.
rewrites.reason: 현재 대화의 확정 ID와 압축 전 전체 원문을 비공개 JSONL로 전달한다.

rewrites.before: One message, three `Task` calls, `subagent_type: generalPurpose`, agent mode (`readonly: false`). Reviewers need MCP access to look up the tickets, chat threads, and observability traces the transcript references, and readonly strips MCPs.
rewrites.after: One message, three native `subagent` calls with `agent: "general", background: true` and the role named below. Use the full agent mode: reviewers need available MCP tools to check the referenced tickets, chat threads and traces. They must not edit files.
rewrites.reason: 3개 관점의 동시 위임과 MCP 접근을 native 인자에 연결한다.

rewrites.before: Each reviewer and the synthesizer name a role line in the `pstack-models.mdc` rule and a default. Set `model` to that line's value, or to the default if the rule or the line is missing. Leave `model` unset when the value is `auto` or `inherit-parent`. If the Task tool rejects a slug, use the default and say so. If it rejects the default, use the closest valid slug of the same family from its error message. Pick each subagent's reasoning level and fast or standard speed for the job, per the Subagents section of the **poteto-mode** skill.
rewrites.after: Each reviewer and the synthesizer names a required `role` in the profile's `pstack-models.json`. Resolve through `pstack_models` and pass that role on every native call. Missing roles keep the defaults below; `auto` and `inherit-parent` retain the parent model. Choose `difficulty` and `urgent` per **poteto-mode**. A rejected adjustment returns to the configured baseline, then this workflow's original role default, then the nearest advertised model in that family; report fallbacks and never reuse rejected identities.
